meta.title: Birra Coffee Export
meta.description: Birra Coffee General Trading PLC specializes in supplying premium Ethiopian Arabica green coffee beans to importers, roasters, wholesalers, and specialty coffee buyers worldwide. From sourcing to delivery, we maintain rigorous quality assurance with strict quality control, traceability, and internationally recognized processing standards.

hero.title:
Ethiopian Coffee.
From Origin to World.
hero.body: Carefully sourced, graded and exported from Ethiopia.

stats.label: ETHIOPIAN REGIONS
stats.desc: Yirgacheffe, Sidama, Guji, Harar, Limu, Jimma and Lekempti.

stats.label: MARKETS SERVED
stats.desc: The Middle East, Europe, the Americas and Asia.

stats.label: ORGANIC CERTIFIED
stats.desc: CERES (EU equivalent) and USDA Organic — supporting access to European and North American organic markets.

stats.label: PROCESSING FACILITIES
stats.desc: Dire Dawa and Sheger City, Oromia.

stats.label: SOURCING
stats.desc: Direct from suppliers through vertical integration and via Ethiopia Commodity Exchange.

stats.label: INDUSTRY MEMBERSHIP
stats.desc: Ethiopian Coffee Exporters Association — the national trade body for Ethiopia's coffee export industry.

items.title: Advanced color sorting
items.desc: State-of-the-art color sorter machines meticulously process raw coffee beans, ensuring unparalleled consistency and eliminating defects.

items.title: Quality control
items.desc: Every lot undergoes comprehensive inspection, grading, cleaning, sorting, and quality control. Discerning hand pickers also hand pick the coffee for the required export standard.

items.title: Sourcing
items.desc: Coffee secured directly from suppliers through vertical integration as well as from Ethiopia Commodity Exchange (ECX), sourcing top quality coffee from reliable local suppliers.

items.title: Skilled workforce
items.desc: Well-organized and experienced management staff with high qualification and long years of experience in coffee marketing. 54 permanent and 250 seasonal workers.

items.title: Traceable supply chain
items.desc: Complete traceability from origin to destination, ensuring consistent quality and customer confidence in every container exported.

items.title: Processing facilities
items.desc: Strategically located processing plants in Dire Dawa and Sheger City, Oromia, equipped with cutting-edge technology for export-quality processing.

packing.title: Packing and formats
packing.body: Packing is agreed per contract. Lined and vacuum options are available on request.

items.title: 60 kg jute bags
items.desc: Standard green coffee packing for export

items.title: Lined jute bags
items.desc: Available on request for specialty lots

items.title: Vacuum packing
items.desc: Available on request for small parcels and samples

documents.title: Documentation pack
documents.body: Prepared per shipment against the lot number. The exact set depends on destination requirements.

journey.title: Eight stages between a cherry and your cup

stages.title: Farm
stages.desc: Grown by smallholder farms and cooperatives across seven Ethiopian regions.

stages.title: Harvest
stages.desc: Selective hand-picking, red cherry only, delivered to the nearest station the same afternoon.

stages.title: Processing
stages.desc: Washed or natural — decided lot by lot against the buyer contract.

stages.title: Quality Control
stages.desc: Graded, cleaned and cupped by trained tasters before it moves on.

stages.title: Roasting
stages.desc: Selected lots roasted in-house, profiled to bring out each origin's character.

stages.title: Packaging
stages.desc: Packed for export, wholesale or retail, in food-grade materials.

stages.title: Export
stages.desc: Documented, compliance-checked and shipped from the port of Djibouti.

stages.title: Customer
stages.desc: From Birra's hands to yours — export partners, wholesalers and everyday drinkers.
